node.title: Dyadic shifted roots are multiplicatively Sidon in characteristic zero
node.statement: Let n=2^s and A=(1-mu_n(C))\{0}. Then ab=cd with a,b,c,d in A forces {a,b}={c,d}; every nonidentity quotient fiber also has multiplicity at most one. Proof: the 2-adic cyclotomic valuation first matches the two valuation levels; separating Q(zeta_{2^j}) over Q(zeta_{2^{j-1}}) then gives either the two factors separately or their sum and product. Hence every finite-field non-equal, non-swap product collision lifts to a nonzero cyclotomic integer alpha=(1-x)(1-y)-(1-u)(1-v) killed modulo the row prime, so p divides Norm(alpha) and 0<|Norm(alpha)|<=6^phi(n). It also gives the exact finite split S_ns=sum_{R(t)>0}Q(t)+sum_t Q(t)(R(t)-1), separating one norm-gate accident from the joint double-accident term. This is not a per-prime aggregate bound or a proof of S_ns^rich<=1200n^2.
